changes: I rewrote `/agent/solver.md` to address the main failure pattern in the development report. Several failed runs submitted without running the public samples, and one submitted a knowingly incomplete placeholder (a BFS that printed -1 for N > 12). The new prompt requires running the samples before submitting, forbids placeholder or fallback programs in the final code, and asks for one combined brute-force, edge-case and timing script to save calls. It also asks the agent to look for structure (per bit, per component, union-find) before coding, and gives an explicit budget plan. `validate()` passes. One trial on the previously failing lcb-arc193-d passed (6 model calls).
